full_details: The new end was "and that is enough." You said it was cheaper than a new player. There was no bill, and the house was not opened. The loaf was a finger and a half short of the notch, and it was not put on a pan. The corn was up and thin. Alse asked if the children were like you. Mistress Ansell said they were well, and she took threepence. The coffer was not counted again.
one_sentence: Garnish pasted the slip and called it against nature, and at dinner Anne's sentence silenced the table for the space of a herring.
title: The mend called against nature, and a short loaf
